Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LXXIV OF 2002
PUNJAB FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXIV OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Finance Act, 1964
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No.Legis.4-7/2001, dated
25-10-2002.------The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Finance
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 13 of Act XXXIV of 1964

ORDINANCE LXXIV OF 2002
PUNJAB FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXIV OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Finance Act, 1964
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No.Legis.4-7/2001, dated
25-10-2002.------The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 13 of
Act XXXIV of 1964.--In the said Act, in section 12 sub-section (1), in
clause (c) of the "Explanation", for the word "kilowatt"
the words "kilo volt ampere" shall be substituted.
